title: FULL STACK Developer Web & Mobile
description:
Key Responsibilities Develop responsive web applications using Next.js . Build and maintain Android/iOS apps using React Native (Expo) or Flutter. Develop scalable REST APIs using Node.js and NestJS. Design and manage PostgreSQL databases and use Redis for caching. Implement JWT authentication, user roles, and API security. Integrate payments, maps, SMS/email, analytics, and push notifications. Deploy and maintain applications using AWS and Docker . Debug production issues and optimize application performance. Write tests, review code, and maintain good development practices. Work independently and guide junior developers when required. Requirements 2+ years of professional full-stack development experience . Experience working with live production applications . Strong hands-on experience with the above technology stack. Good knowledge of Git, debugging, REST APIs, databases, and cloud deployment. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to take ownership of features from development to production. Compensation & Application Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and interview.

Key Skills: Fullstack Development,Java,Javascript,Node.js,AWS,Angular,Python,Web technologies
